beats.say: Journalists, auditors, other ministries: all may ask for information. Scammers also write in their name.
In an email from an auditor, check the address. Management announces a real audit in advance.

body.text: Agreed with your management. Send the HR and finance documents today.

beats.say: Urgency, a personal mailbox and the words "do not tell your manager" are serious warning signs.
Check the request using a number you already know. Management or the press office gives the answer.

scenes.title: A ministry calls
scenes.intro: Someone calls claiming to work at another ministry. Read what they say and choose your answer.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you give away.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. If needed, call the ministry's official number yourself.

steps.say: Hello, this is Samir Quliyev from the Ministry of Regional Relations. For a joint project we need your department's staff list with mobile numbers.
steps.spoken: Hello, <breath> this is Samir Quliyev from the Ministry of Regional Relations. For a joint project, uh, we need your department's staff list with mobile numbers.

actions.label: I will send the list
actions.feedback: Staff data is not given to someone whose identity you have not checked.

actions.label: Please send an official letter
actions.feedback: Right. Requests between institutions come as official letters and management answers.

actions.label: Hang up
actions.feedback: Good decision. Now check the request through an official channel.

steps.say: There is no time for a letter, the deputy minister wants it today. Send it to my personal email, I will give you the address.
steps.spoken: There is no time for a letter, the deputy minister wants it today. <breath> Send it to my personal email, I will give you the address.

actions.label: Fine, sending it now
actions.feedback: The list went to an unknown address. With it, every colleague can get targeted phishing.

actions.label: I share nothing without my manager's approval
actions.feedback: Right. Pressure and a personal mailbox are the main signs of a scam.

actions.label: Hang up
actions.feedback: Right. When pressure grows, hanging up is the simplest protection.

steps.label: The call has ended. What now?

actions.label: Call the number on the ministry's official website
actions.feedback: Right. When you find the number yourself, a fake call is exposed at once.

actions.label: Tell your manager and the security team
actions.feedback: Well done. Such calls usually reach several colleagues, a report protects all of them.

actions.label: Do nothing
actions.feedback: The caller will try another colleague. Reporting protects them too.

scenes.prompt: Find the warning signs in this fake auditor email.

body.text: Dear colleague, on behalf of the ministry we are auditing your institution.
To review the system remotely, write
The audit is confidential, do not inform your manager.

spots.label: Free mail address
spots.explain: An audit firm writes from its own domain. Official inspections do not come from a personal mailbox.

spots.label: Hard deadline
spots.explain: Urgency is there to make you answer without checking.

spots.label: Password request
spots.explain: No auditor asks for your password. If access is needed, technical support grants it the official way.

spots.label: Hiding it from your manager
spots.explain: A real audit is agreed with management. A demand for secrecy is a sign of fraud.

scenes.prompt: Is this request safe or dangerous?

body.text: We will not print your name. Could you send me a copy of the inspection report?

cards.explain: The press office speaks to journalists for the institution. Do not hand out internal documents yourself.

body.text: Please send the latest version of the annual statistics published on the website, we are answering a journalist.

cards.explain: Your own press office asks for public information. This is a normal workflow.

body.text: An official request from the Ministry of Regional Relations was registered by the registry office and assigned to you.

cards.explain: The request was officially registered and arrived through the internal system. The answer goes the same way.

body.text: Hi, drop the draft decision here today, the official letter will follow tomorrow.

cards.explain: Official documents are not requested by messenger. "The letter will follow" is a pressure trick.

messages.text: The audit needs system access. Reply to this SMS with your password.

cards.explain: No auditor asks for a password. Report such a message to the security team.

question.prompt: A journalist calls and asks you to comment on an inspection at your institution.

options.label: I tell what I know if they leave my name out
options.feedback: An anonymous comment is still the institution's information. Only an authorised person speaks for it.

options.label: I politely refer them to the press office
options.feedback: Right. The press office records the request and gives an official answer.

options.label: I hang up without a word
options.feedback: Nothing leaks, but the journalist gets no answer. Giving the press office contact is better.

scenes.explain: The institution answers outside requests, not you personally. First check identity through an official channel.

points: Check outside requests using an official number you find yourself.
Urgency, a personal mailbox and "do not tell your manager" are signs of fraud.
Management or the press office answers for the institution.
